visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress with a keyhole cutout and a cream-colored cape, walks away from the camera down a modern hotel hallway with warm lighting and wooden wall panels. (2) The woman steps out of a sleek black van, holding a vibrant red leather clutch; she smiles towards the camera while a man in a blue suit stands nearby in the background against a classic European building. (3) On a sunny day, the woman points towards a serene lake surrounded by lush green mountains; she wears a decorative hair clip and is accompanied by a man in a formal suit as they walk along a stone path. (4) Inside an ornate building featuring high arched ceilings, intricate frescoes, and gold-leaf details, the woman socializes with various guests in formal attire; she is seen walking up a red-carpeted staircase and standing on a marble balcony. (5) Transitioning to a night event with blue neon lighting, the woman poses with a small red clutch in a ballroom setting; a man on stage delivers a speech in front of a large screen displaying the 'DRX' logo and a '4' symbol. (6) A group of people in formal wear stand in a circle on a lawn at night, putting their hands together in a celebratory gesture, followed by a vibrant display of fireworks bursting in the dark sky above a large mansion. (7) A final static graphic appears on a grey background, displaying the 'DRX Dermatology Clinic' logo in black, along with social media handles, phone numbers, and addresses in both Taipei and New Taipei City.
